text: In accordance with Section C.4. of the Terms of Reference, at its first meeting or as soon as possible, the City-School Boards Advisory Committee will elect a Trustee member as Vice Chair.

The City-School Boards Advisory Committee: 1. Elected Yalini Rajakulasingam as Vice Chair of the City-School Boards Advisory Committee for a term of office starting on June 18, 2024 and ending November 14, 2026, and until a successor is appointed.
